faq.a: Granger 3600LX is a vehicle listed for GTA 6 on the GTA Fandom wiki, made in game by Declasse. The wiki entry is the only record of it. Rockstar has not named it in a trailer, a press release or on the Grand Theft Auto VI site, so this page records the wiki listing and marks it as a community source.

No. A Fandom wiki page is written by fans, not by Rockstar. This site files Granger 3600LX as community identified, at low confidence, for that reason. The entry stays at low confidence until Rockstar or a major outlet names it.

faq.q: What does the wiki say about Granger 3600LX?
faq.a: The wiki gives 5 details. Manufacturer: Declasse. Class: SUVs. Body style: 4-door SUV (Although found in special section of the website.). Seats: 8. Listed price: $2,000,000. Those are wiki fields copied as they stand. No figure here was measured in the game, because the game has not released.

faq.q: Where does this Granger 3600LX information come from?
faq.a: From the GTA Fandom wiki page for Granger 3600LX, collected by the outlawdb project on 2026-09-13 and released under CC BY-SA 3.0. The source link on this page opens the wiki page itself, so you can read the same entry.

faq.q: What is still unknown about Granger 3600LX?
faq.a: Most of it. Granger 3600LX rests on a fan wiki listing and nothing else. Top speed, handling and stats and a gta 6 price are both unpublished. Rockstar answers questions like this at launch, not before, so this page will change when it does.

faq.q: Will Granger 3600LX be in the finished GTA 6?
faq.a: Not known. A wiki listing is a claim by a fan editor, not a Rockstar statement. Plenty of vehicle entries written before a launch never appear in the game. This site records the claim and the source, and marks the entry unconfirmed until that changes.
